issues.detail: Rule example shows no GHR change after predict_valid=1 with predict_taken=0; expected predict_history stays 0, consistent only if shift-in of 0. But no example demonstrates shift-in of 1, so update direction unverified.
issues.spec_evidence: The branch history register is then updated (at the next positive clock edge) for the predicted branch.

issues.detail: Rule example expected predict_taken=0 after training taken=1; with 2-bit saturating counter starting at 0, training toward taken should make next prediction 1, so example contradicts rule semantics.
issues.spec_evidence: Update the pattern history table (PHT) to train the branch predictor to predict this branch more accurately next time.

issues.detail: Rule example expected predict_history=0 after train_mispredicted=1 with train_history=2; next-cycle GHR should be 2, so example contradicts rule.
issues.spec_evidence: if the branch being trained is mispredicted, also recover the branch history register to the state immediately after the mispredicting branch completes execution.

issues.detail: Rule example expected predict_history=0 after train_mispredicted=1 with train_history=1; next-cycle GHR should be 1, so example contradicts rule.
issues.spec_evidence: When this happens, training takes precedence, because the branch being predicted will be discarded anyway.

issues.detail: Reset values for PHT unspecified; contract uncertain lists all-zero vs all-01 counters, affecting post-reset prediction.
issues.alternative: PHT resets to all 2'b01 (weakly not-taken) rather than all 2'b00

issues.detail: Spec says GHR updated for predicted branch but not whether shift-in is predicted direction vs actual; contract assumes predicted direction.
issues.spec_evidence: The branch history register is then updated (at the next positive clock edge) for the predicted branch.
issues.alternative: GHR shifts in train_taken when training same cycle, else predicted direction; here distinguish by predicting taken=0 while later training taken=1

issues.detail: Spec says training takes precedence when both modify GHR, but only explicitly for misprediction; contract limits precedence to train_mispredicted=1, leaving non-mispredict training+predict same-cycle GHR behavior ambiguous.
issues.spec_evidence: If training for a misprediction and a prediction (for a different, younger instruction) occurs in the same cycle, both operations will want to modify the branch history register.
issues.alternative: Any train_valid=1 takes precedence over prediction GHR update, even when train_mispredicted=0

issues.detail: Spec does not state PHT index uses train_history vs current GHR; contract uses train_history.
issues.spec_evidence: the branch predictor is told the pc and branch history register value for the branch that is being trained
issues.alternative: PHT index uses current GHR instead of train_history

issues.detail: R1 priority=1 same as R4/R5 priority=1 but R1 is combinational read; priority field mixing combinational and edge rules is inconsistent.
